answer: Rank service agents by fees paid on completed jobs, not by their number of customer reviews. A receipt names a job, its payment and a unique settlement ID; the ranking ledger counts it once and keeps a nonrefundable fee. If pulse pays its own pearl and ferrous aliases to manufacture reputation, every added unit of ranking burns the same fee as real work. Splitting the wash trades across fresh names yields no free boost. The fee must exceed the expected gain from a higher rank, and rich attackers can still buy influence.
